'ReviewMPartition.averaged_partition' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
theorem NDivisorialShells.descended_partition_mass.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  (v : ℕ → NumberField.FinitePlace K) (b : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ b x) →
    (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun q => b ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * x)) 1) →
      ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
        (∀ (e : Option ℕ), 0 ≤ NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v b e x) ∧
          HasSum (fun e => NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v b e x) 1 :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] v b hb hbs x =>
  Quotient.inductionOn x fun y =>
    have ht :=
      ReviewMPartition.averaged_partition (fun q => b ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * y))
        (fun e q => NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * y))
        (fun q => hb ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * y)) (hbs y)
        (fun e q => NDivisorialShells.upstairs_nonneg K v e ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * y)) fun q =>
        NDivisorialShells.upstairs_mass K v ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * y);
    ⟨ht.right.left, ht.right.right⟩

theorem ReviewM.shell_reconstruction.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace X]
  [Countable ι] (μ : Measure X) (p : ι → X → ℝ),
  ReviewM.PositivePartition p →
    ∀ (f : X → ℂ), Integrable f μ → HasSum (fun i => ∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * f x ∂μ) (∫ (x : X), f x ∂μ) :=
fun {X} {ι} [MeasurableSpace X] [Countable ι] μ p hp f hf =>
  have hi := fun i => ReviewM.shell_integrable μ p hp f hf i;
  have hb := fun F =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ∫ (x : X), ‖f x‖ ∂μ)
          (Eq.symm (integral_finset_sum F fun i x => Integrable.norm (hi i)))))
      (integral_mono (integrable_finset_sum F fun i x => Integrable.norm (hi i)) (Integrable.norm hf) fun x =>
        id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a => norm_mul (↑(p x_1 x)) (f x))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                  (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a =>
                    congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * ‖f x‖) (Complex.norm_real (p x_1 x)))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                    (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a => Eq.refl (|p x_1 x| * ‖f x‖))))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun x_1 => x_1 ≤ ‖f x‖)
                      (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl F) fun x_1 a =>
                        congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * ‖f x‖)
                          ((fun x_0 x_1 => (fun x_0 x_1 => abs_of_nonneg (hp.nonneg x_0 x_1)) x_0 x_1) x_1 x))))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≤ ‖f x‖) (Eq.symm (Finset.sum_mul F (fun x_1 => p x_1 x) ‖f x‖))))
                    (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg (f x)) (ReviewM.partition_partial_le p hp F x))))))));
  have hs := summable_of_sum_le (fun i => integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg (↑(p i x) * f x)) hb;
  have he := fun x =>
    have ht := HasSum.tsum_eq (HasSum.mul_right (f x) (ContinuousLinearMap.hasSum Complex.ofRealCLM (hp.mass x)));
    Eq.mp (congrArg (Eq (∑' (b : ι), ↑(p b x) * f x)) (one_mul (f x))) ht;
  Eq.mp
    (congrArg (fun x => HasSum (fun x => ∫ (a : X), ↑(p x a) * f a ∂μ) (integral μ x))
      (funext fun a => (fun x => he x) a))
    (hasSum_integral_of_summable_integral_norm hi hs)

theorem NDivisorialShells.descended_positivePartition_of_indentation.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] (v : ℕ → NumberField.FinitePlace K) (b : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ),
  Continuous b →
    (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ b x) →
      (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun q => b ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * x)) 1) →
        ReviewM.PositivePartition (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v b) :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] v b hb hb0 hbs =>
  {
    measurable := fun e =>
      Continuous.measurable (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask_continuous_of_indentation K v b hb hb0 hbs e),
    nonneg := fun e x => (NDivisorialShells.descended_partition_mass K v b hb0 hbs x).left e,
    mass := fun x => (NDivisorialShells.descended_partition_mass K v b hb0 hbs x).right }

theorem HNormalizedKernel.diagonalL2Cost_eq_norm_mul.{u_1} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X]
  (nu : Measure X) (U R : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)), HNormalizedKernel.diagonalL2Cost nu U R = ‖U‖ * ‖R‖ :=
fun {X} [MeasurableSpace X] nu U R =>
  have hsq := fun F =>
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congr (congrArg (fun x => Eq (integral nu x)) (funext fun x => Real.rpow_two ‖↑↑F x‖))
              (congrArg (integral nu) (funext fun x => real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq (↑↑F x))))
            (eq_self (∫ (x : X), ‖↑↑F x‖ ^ 2 ∂nu))))
        (Eq.symm (L2.inner_def F F)))
      (real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq F);
  id
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ^ (1 / 2) * (∫ (x : X), ‖↑↑R x‖ ^ 2 ∂nu) ^ (1 / 2) = ‖U‖ * ‖R‖) (hsq U)))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (‖U‖ ^ 2) ^ (1 / 2) * _a ^ (1 / 2) = ‖U‖ * ‖R‖) (hsq R)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * (‖R‖ ^ 2) ^ (1 / 2) = ‖U‖ * ‖R‖) (Eq.symm (Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (‖U‖ ^ 2)))))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => √(‖U‖ ^ 2) * _a = ‖U‖ * ‖R‖) (Eq.symm (Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (‖R‖ ^ 2)))))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * √(‖R‖ ^ 2) = ‖U‖ * ‖R‖) (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg U))))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ‖U‖ * _a = ‖U‖ * ‖R‖) (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg R))))
                (Eq.refl (‖U‖ * ‖R‖))))))))

theorem NDivisorialShells.actual_incoming_row_boundary.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] (v : ℕ → NumberField.FinitePlace K) (indent : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ),
  Continuous indent →
    (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ indent x) →
      (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun q => indent ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * x)) 1) →
        ∀ (nu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (w : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ),
          (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), 0 < w x) →
            ∀ (vol : ℝ),
              0 < vol →
                ∀ (U R : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (t : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  HasSum
                      (fun e =>
                        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                          (↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e x) -
                              ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e (x * t⁻¹))) *
                            HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu)
                      0 ∧
                    (Summable fun e =>
                        ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                            (↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e x) -
                                ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e (x * t⁻¹))) *
                              HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu‖) ∧
                      ∑' (e : Option ℕ),
                          ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                              (↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e x) -
                                  ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e (x * t⁻¹))) *
                                HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu‖ ≤
                        2 * (‖U‖ * ‖R‖) :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] v indent hb hb0 hbs nu w hw vol hvol U R t =>
  have hp := NDivisorialShells.descended_positivePartition_of_indentation K v indent hb hb0 hbs;
  have hq :=
    ReviewM.partition_pullback (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent) hp (fun x => x * t⁻¹)
      (Continuous.measurable (Continuous.mul continuous_id continuous_const));
  have hi := HNormalizedKernel.diagonal_integrable nu w hw vol U R;
  have h :=
    ReviewM.partition_boundary_integrals (ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu) (NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent)
      (fun e x => NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e (x * t⁻¹)) hp hq
      (fun x => HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x) hi;
  ⟨h.left,
    ⟨h.right.left,
      LE.le.trans h.right.right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (LE.le
                (∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  ‖HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x‖ ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu))
              (HNormalizedKernel.diagonalL2Cost_eq_norm_mul nu U R))
            (HNormalizedKernel.diagonal_integral_norm_le nu w hw vol hvol U R))
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl true)))⟩⟩

NDivisorialShells.actual_incoming_row_boundary.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (v : ℕ → NumberField.FinitePlace K) (indent : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ) (hb : Continuous indent)
  (hb0 : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ indent x)
  (hbs : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun q => indent ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * x)) 1)
  (nu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (w : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ)
  (hw : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), 0 < w x) (vol : ℝ) (hvol : 0 < vol) (U R : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (t : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  HasSum
      (fun e =>
        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
          (↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e x) -
              ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e (x * t⁻¹))) *
            HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu)
      0 ∧
    (Summable fun e =>
        ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
            (↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e x) -
                ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e (x * t⁻¹))) *
              HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu‖) ∧
      ∑' (e : Option ℕ),
          ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
              (↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e x) -
                  ↑(NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v indent e (x * t⁻¹))) *
                HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w vol (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu‖ ≤
        2 * (‖U‖ * ‖R‖)
